# FDGA030

> DO specify the `extern` method modifier immediately after the `static` modifier for an `extern` method.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.5 Member Modifiers.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0036
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## From the book

```csharp
Right: private static extern IntPtr CreateFile(...);
Wrong: private extern static IntPtr CreateFile(...);
```
